'''Galactic Sales Representative''' was a position within the company [[Thulpin Agriculture]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]]. An undercover [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agent posed as one of Thulpin Agriculture's Galactic Sales Representatives during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
